source_claim: AlphaEvolve Section 2.1 describes the user-provided code inside evolvable blocks as a complete initial solution that is runnable through the supplied task skeleton and evaluator before evolution
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve exposes an alphaevolve_strict initial-program validity policy and runtime report for seed evaluator validity, declared metric presence, archive admission state, strict valid/invalid counts, and strict stop evidence. The embedded_evaluate_math fixture is a strict single-seed smoke fixture, not a benchmark-suite certification row. Strict runtime reports can be claim-ready only for configured strict runs where every selected seed is evaluator-valid and metric-complete. The default permissive baseline keeps invalid seeds as diagnostics and does not claim AlphaEvolve complete initial-program parity.
